digest.component_or_area: CLI parser and help-generation artifact stability
propositions: Four rendered non-bridge advanced parser factories (metrics, audit, bridge-fsck, bridge-probe) use the stdlib argparse.HelpFormatter instead of the version-pinned RebarHelpFormatter, creating width inconsistency (78 vs 80) and py3.13 regression risk in generated help artifacts.

Help-backed routes that render through stock argparse.HelpFormatter may generate different help output under py3.13 (short+long metavar rendering, usage wrapping) than py3.11/3.12, silently staling gen_cli_help.py --check and docs without failing CI.
Contract test validates that all help-backed (rendered) routes use RebarHelpFormatter subclass; four factories fail this assertion before fix.
Regenerating help artifacts with RebarHelpFormatter fixes width-80 canonicalization for bridge-fsck and aligns all rendered advanced routes to deterministic cross-version rendering.
